description: Incoming settings inclusion gated by permissions. A node may carry incoming settings (endpoints, permissions). Those settings are included in the resolved group only when incoming permissions are enabled on the server. When incoming permissions are disabled, the service name is cleared and the incoming section is stripped to its empty default even if the node supplied endpoints. When incoming permissions are enabled, the service name and the incoming endpoints are retained. Output reports the group type, mode, service name, sorted dependencies, and the incoming-section summary.
